digest.component_or_area: bridge state store and migration protocol
propositions: Three format changes to committed .bridge_state require an ADR documenting architectural decisions for mixed-version protocol and rollback boundaries.

Mixed-version reads use chronological max(new, legacy) to safely interleave writers; A2-2 cutover gate requires A2-1 merged, successful descendant reconcile workflow, explicit host probe refresh, and direct deployment evidence.
Format changes are incrementally reversible: A2-1 reversible, A3 reversible through idempotent canonicalization, A2-2 requires recorded corpus, A4-2 requires forward and reverse evidence.
Committed bridge state on branch is required for ephemeral runner durability; prior art follows docs/migrations.md expand/contract and epic 6c9c-811f-6dc4-40e7 cutover patterns.
Measured compression from 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB after A1 deletion; 218/399 identical prev key sets; assignee excluded from normalization because _assignee_candidates requires raw shape.

ADR 0060 enumerates A1 (baseline_advanced_at deletion), A2 (last_get_pass relocation), A3 (scalar baseline normalization), A4-2 (prev_snapshot narrowing), and cites session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4 with no elapsed-time requirement.
